name: Jari Mäkinen
bio:
Jari's journey into motorsport began unexpectedly. He always had a knack for detail and a love for cars, but it was a chance encounter with a local rally team that sparked his passion. He started by simply helping clean and maintain the cars but quickly became fascinated by the art of paintwork and the importance of aerodynamics.

Over the years, Jari honed his skills, working his way up through various motorsport teams. He is known for his meticulous approach and his ability to visualize the bigger picture. Jari doesn't just apply paint; he sees the car as a whole, understanding how the paint affects performance and aesthetics. His experience ranges from classic rally cars to cutting-edge single-seaters, making him a versatile asset to any team.

At Prema Junior, Jari brings his visionary approach to the forefront. He constantly seeks innovative solutions to improve paint durability, reduce weight, and enhance aerodynamic efficiency. He is always willing to experiment and push the boundaries of what is possible.

physical.description: Jari is of average height with a wiry build, often seen with a focused expression.

quirks: Always polishes his glasses before starting a new project.
Has a collection of vintage automotive paint samples.
Hums quietly while working, often Finnish folk songs.
